definitions.explanation: To go beyond a limit or amount.

definitions.gloss: to pass through, to tide over
definitions.explanation: To get through a difficult time.

notes:
{超|こ}す is a godan verb meaning to exceed or surpass a limit.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: 〜を{超|こ}す

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {予算|よさん}を{超|こ}す: to exceed the budget
- {限度|げんど}を{超|こ}す: to exceed the limit
- {予想|よそう}を{超|こ}す: to exceed expectations
- {百万|ひゃくまん}を{超|こ}す: to exceed one million

KANJI DISTINCTION (same reading):
- {超|こ}す: to exceed, surpass (abstract limits)
- {越|こ}す: to cross over, pass through (physical movement)

SIMILAR:
- {超|こ}える: same meaning (ichidan verb variant)
- {上回|うわまわ}る: to surpass, exceed
